Author: `/root`. 29 October 2026 Australia/Brisbane. Status at creation: analytic construction, with executable checks and independent review recorded separately. This builds on the reviewed finite-algebra theorem and the explicit two-unitary extractor. It is not a claim of hardware advantage or historical priority.

## 1. The operation being compiled

An acquired source dilation has a finite source alphabet and ordered branches

\[
V_x=\prod_{i=1}^n V_i^{x_i},\qquad
V_i=\bigotimes_{t=1}^T U_{i,t},\qquad x_i\in\{0,1\}.
\]

A known source unitary G, diagonal in the source-label basis and including actual ordered-product cocycles, is to be preserved. Batch generators obey the exact bounded-unitary relations

\[
U_{i,t}U_{j,t}=(-1)^{C_{t,ij}}U_{j,t}U_{i,t},\qquad
B_t=\sum_{s\leq t}C_s\pmod2.
\]

Let rank(B_t)=2r_t and assume B_T=0. The original source, all batches and a reference may be arbitrarily correlated. A receiver may control the actual U_{i,t} with a qubit; it has finite qubit gates, preparation and readout. It may retire processed field systems, but every quantum system crossing an arrival cut counts as memory. It does not gain a new source coupling.

The construction below retains **r_t qubits after batch t**, emits only finite actual records, and approximates the complete corrected source/reference/record instrument by G followed by the **same actual receiver on the common input**. No exact Zak transform, sign-observable oracle, central spectral measurement or GKP codeword is supplied.

The reviewed exact lower bound still says r_t qubits are necessary for zero error. This document does not claim that they minimize memory at every nonzero error. The separate two-generator operation-error converse establishes a nonzero-error separation in its stated case.

The construction never substitutes nearby rational Weyl operators for U,V. They may act on any separable Hilbert space, and all bounds are operator bounds valid for arbitrary input/reference states, without a field-energy restriction.

The receiver requires supplied controlled-U and controlled-V operations, fresh finite-dimensional registers, specified finite state preparation and Fourier gates, measurements, and record-controlled qubit rotations. Controlled access is an additional physical interface; ordinary unknown black-box access to U,V is not asserted to supply it. Errors in implementing these queried operations must be charged separately. During extraction the captured field is still available; only afterward is it retired.

After two such arrivals, one extracted qubit from the first is retained and paired with the second in a standard Bell measurement. All phase-estimation and Bell outcomes are retained. The source receives only record-dependent diagonal feedback, deferred until permitted by the actual interaction schedule. No new source-to-field coupling is used.

Author `/root`, 29 October 2026 Australia/Brisbane. New construction; executed evidence and actual independent review are separate. Physical memory noise is not assumed automatically Pauli.

## 1. Consequence and contract

The finite receiver protects a specified matrix factor. Its usefulness for computing depends on how faults of that factor change the source operation. The retained Pauli frames give an explicit answer including every actual receiver record, and an exact error for the noise class below.

There are n source qubits with the full binary label space. The source dilation and target G are diagonal in that basis. At cut t the compiled source branches act through ordered words in fixed Hermitian Pauli operators P_i^(t) on r_t retained qubits; scalar phases are in the actual classical history. The later receiver exactly erases that remaining family, or approximates its complete operation with uniform compiler allowance epsilon_c.

At each storage boundary insert a Pauli Q_t on the retained register. A fault path f=(Q_1,...,Q_(T-1)) has a classical joint probability p_f independent of the initial source, field and reference. Arbitrary time correlations are allowed; the law need not factorize, and the field need not be freshly prepared. The matrices and schedule are fixed, so each cut has the same known P_i on every actual history.

This premise is an actual state-independent Pauli noise process. It is not obtained by expanding arbitrary Kraus operators in the Pauli basis, quoting mean infidelity, or twirling a marginal while retaining hidden control/environment dependence. Faults during extraction, readout or source contact need separate compatible contracts.

If a memory error-correction instrument supplies an input-independent joint law of logical Pauli faults and observed syndrome h, include h in the path and the actual receiver record. Its state-independent logical instrument, preparation, control and syndrome acquisition must be supplied; this theorem does not certify them.
